name: B10-0109/2025 (S&D) – Escalation of violence in the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the escalation of violence in the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for an immediate ceasefire in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, where the M23 rebel group, backed by Rwanda, has seized the city of Goma and caused thousands of deaths. It asks Rwanda to withdraw its troops and stop supporting M23. It wants a humanitarian corridor so aid can reach displaced people, and it urges the European Commission to suspend its raw materials agreement with Rwanda. The Parliament is stating its position; it is not changing any law itself.

- The Parliament asks the EU Commission to suspend its minerals agreement with Rwanda and pause new mining project plans there.
- It calls on Rwanda to pull its troops out of eastern Congo and on all sides to stop fighting.
- It urges more emergency aid, a humanitarian corridor, and the reopening of Goma airport for relief.
